basic_profile.bio: An avid tech enthusiast from Melbourne, Australia, who recently discovered the world of Reddit. During the day, I work as a junior software developer, mainly focusing on mobile app development. In my free time, I love exploring different music genres, especially ska and trap, and engaging in thought-provoking debates online. I'm happily married and expecting our first child, which has piqued my interest in parenting communities. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and have been working in the tech industry for about a year. My technical skills are mostly self-taught through online courses and hands-on projects. I have a keen interest in mobile app development and am constantly learning about the latest trends in technology.
